# This file helps large language models discover and understand Acedit.ai's platform, features, and educational resources for AI-powered interview preparation.

> Acedit.ai is an AI-powered interview preparation platform offering real-time coaching, STAR-method answers, personalized responses, and career optimization tools in multiple languages.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://www.acedit.ai) – AI-powered job interview preparation platform.
- [Features Overview](https://www.acedit.ai/features) – Explore all Acedit.ai features.
- [Affiliate Partner](https://www.acedit.ai/affiliate-partner) – Join the affiliate program.
- [FAQ](https://www.acedit.ai/frequently-asked-questions) – Get answers about using Acedit.ai.

## Key Features
- [Personalized Answer Suggestions](https://www.acedit.ai/features/personalized-answer-suggestions) – AI-generated responses tailored to your experience.
- [Real-Time Coaching](https://www.acedit.ai/features/real-time-coaching) – Live feedback during mock interviews.
- [LinkedIn Integration](https://www.acedit.ai/features/linkedin-integration) – Leverage LinkedIn data for better responses.
- [AI Cover Letter Generation](https://www.acedit.ai/features/ai-cover-letter-generation) – Create ATS-friendly cover letters instantly.
- [AI Interview Simulation](https://www.acedit.ai/features/ai-interview-simulation) – Practice with AI-powered interview bots.
